Any chance of providing a small reproducer project?

@gastaldi @antonwiens Reproducer attached, using only the `quarkus-resteasy-jaxb` dependency; as the `quarkus-cxf` dependency is not quite relevant for this issue.

[code-with-quarkus.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/8782978/code-with-quarkus.zip)

For the passing use case, you can execute:
`mvn clean install -Dquarkus.platform.version=2.8.0.Final -Dnative`

For the failure use case:
`mvn clean install -Dnative`

I believe the issue has existed since 2.8.1.Final.

issue.title: Remove the substitution for LocatableAnnotation
issue.body:
This commit reverts the substitution introduced in e93a20d139415aa2986a75006b64f40343bcd428 which was removed previously in daec663d06ff028133127243d4afeefec40a3ee6

- Fixes #25325
